_how_to_run: In PowerShell, from the project folder: python simulation\solve.py --config simulation\solve-config.json
_how_to_stop: Ctrl+C once finishes the current iteration and saves. Ctrl+C twice quits without saving.
_iters: How many CFR+ iterations. About 0.2 seconds each. See HANDOFF.md 'How many iterations' for what each amount buys.
_report_every: Print a progress line every this many iterations.
_checkpoints: Also save a copy of the policy at these iterations, so a crash or a stop still leaves a usable file. [] for none.
_out: Where the finished policy is written. Feed this to build-gto-policy.mjs.
_max_quantity: Highest bid quantity solved. 10 is every die on the table.
_reroll: Straight re-roll rule folded into the dice odds: none, no-one, or all. Leave on none until the rule is decided (HANDOFF.md gap 5).
